newsitem.title: USA: PECO to manage USX Fairless energy needs.
newsitem.headline: PECO to manage USX Fairless energy needs.

text.p: Exelon Corp said Friday its first contract for energy infrastructure operations and maintenance services is with USX Realty Development Corp.

The PECO Energy Co subsidiary said the USX-U.S. Steel Group operation agreed to a two-year arrangement that covers management of electric and natural gas distribution systems on the 3,000-acre USX property in Fairless Hill, Bucks County, Pa.
USX buys bulk power, but had maintained its own electric transmission substation and distribution facilities at its Fairless Works.
Likewise, natural gas is delivered to a "gate station" on the property, and USX personnel maintained on-site gas distribution.
Effective June 1, Exelon assumed responsibility for the operations of these electric and gas distribution systems, providing round-the-clock coverage.

Exelon said its technicians will manage the 13,000-volt (13-kv) distribution system and more than three miles of gas pipeline. Ten employees are being devoted to the USX property, which is being developed as a business park, PECO spokesman Michael Wood said.
Including USX's sheet and tin operations, the industrial complex hosts five other businesses: Crown Cork & Seal Co Inc, Chicago Steel, LaClede Steel and Clean Soils Inc.
This Exelon contract follows PECO's purchase last December of USX's steam powerhouse. Both agreements allow USX to direct its efforts toward quality steel production, Exelon said.
The company is PECO's recently formed Valley Forge-based nonregulated subsidiary.
